# Kenney assets (CC0)

Third-party art stored for reuse across the project. All packs below are **CC0 1.0** ([Creative Commons Zero](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)). Credit to [Kenney](https://kenney.nl) is appreciated but not required.

| Folder | Pack | Source |
|--------|------|--------|
| `GenericItems/` | Generic Items (160× PNGs) | [kenney.nl/assets/generic-items](https://kenney.nl/assets/generic-items) · [OpenGameArt mirror](https://opengameart.org/content/generic-items) |
| `GameIcons/` | Game Icons (105 UI icons, black 1×) | [kenney.nl/assets/game-icons](https://kenney.nl/assets/game-icons) · [OpenGameArt mirror](https://opengameart.org/content/game-icons) |

Each subfolder includes Kenney’s `License.txt` from the download.

HUD wood icon: `Assets/Art/Icons/HUD/wood-log.png` (CC0 item icon from [freegameui.net](https://freegameui.net/assets/icons/ic_item_wood-log/) — Kenney’s UI packs do not include a log glyph).
